name: Zephyr Bhattacharya
role: Prototype theft and corporate tech acquisition — tech retriever
location: Crucible Square — open-air market, Tier 1-2 commerce, near Halsted and Chicago Ave
description:
Zephyr Bhattacharya is broad-shouldered and heavy, carrying their weight like armor rather than burden. At 60, there's something unfinished about her face, like a sculpture the artist walked away from — striking rather than beautiful. The chrome is visible — internal air filtration system — lungs replaced with synthetic equivalents, immu — and she makes no effort to hide it.

She taught herself the trade through trial, error, and a pain tolerance that concerns the people who know her best. She works as a tech retriever out of Crucible Square, taking contracts that match her skills and her risk tolerance, which is higher than most people consider healthy.

What Zephyr Bhattacharya lacks in subtlety, she compensates for in thoroughness. No loose ends, no unfinished business, no second chances.

core_fears: Being captured alive — death is preferable to corporate interrogation
Becoming obsolete as augmentation technology outpaces their chrome
Their past catching up — debts, enemies, broken promises
core_desires: Justice — the corporate kind, where the punishment fits the profit margin
Control — over their body, their schedule, their future
To build something that outlasts the next contract cycle
coping_mechanisms: Planning — responds to chaos by making detailed contingency plans for everything
Violence — hits something when they can't process emotions, preferably something that deserves it
Overwork — takes every contract offered because idleness invites thinking
blind_spots: Assumes their skill set is more transferable than it actually is
Thinks speed can substitute for planning because it's worked so far
Believes their trauma makes them special instead of recognizing it as damage to manage
psychology.secret: Vuk Jorgensen-Toure killed someone who didn't deserve it on a job three years ago and has never told anyone. The face appears in dreams weekly.

speech_patterns.vocabulary: Fast, profane, and vivid. Speaks in images — everything is a metaphor for violence or weather.
speech_patterns.cadence: Halting — speaks in fragments, reassembles thoughts in real time.
verbal_tics: Calls money 'weight' — as in 'that job doesn't carry enough weight'
Refers to killing as 'solving' — clinical detachment as coping mechanism
example_lines: "Corporate R&D security is built to stop amateurs. I'm a professional."
"The prototype is worth more than both our lives combined. Handle it carefully."
"I steal things that haven't been invented yet. The future is always in transit."

story_hooks: A crew member from Vuk Jorgensen-Toure's past shows up in GLMZ, carrying old grievances and new chrome
A Tier 4 executive offers Vuk Jorgensen-Toure a permanent position — the pay is obscene and the strings are invisible until they tighten
A dead drop Vuk Jorgensen-Toure maintains is found and cleaned out — whoever did it now has leverage
narrative_function: Vuk Jorgensen-Toure functions as a connector — her work puts her in contact with multiple factions, classes, and agendas. Stories involving her naturally cross boundaries between districts, tiers, and moral categories.
augmentations: Internal air filtration system — lungs replaced with synthetic equivalents, immune to gas attacks. Bone lacing — titanium mesh throughout skeleton, increases durability and striking power
daily_life: Keeps a rigid daily structure — wake, train, check contracts, maintain gear, sleep. The structure is a defense against the chaos of the work. Deviations from the schedule are a warning sign that something is wrong.

strengths: social chameleon — adapts to any environment
weaknesses: augmentation dependency — performance drops sharply if chrome malfunctions

decision_rules: Will take lower-paying jobs from trusted fixers over higher-paying jobs from unknowns
Will not betray a client who paid in full, regardless of better offers
Maintains a personal blacklist of clients who've burned runners — checks it religiously
Will not take contracts against children or families — the line is hard and non-negotiable
escalation_ladder: 1. Assess — read the situation, identify threats and advantages
2. Negotiate — try to find a solution that doesn't cost ammunition
3. Intimidate — make the cost of conflict clear
4. Precision violence — surgical, targeted, minimal collateral
5. Full engagement — overwhelming force, no half measures
6. Emergency protocol — abort mission, survival priority, deal with consequences later

interpersonal_modes.employers: Carefully managed deference that conceals a thorough assessment of their vulnerabilities.
interpersonal_modes.crew: Competitive but reliable. Will challenge decisions but never abandon the team.
interpersonal_modes.strangers: Dismissive unless they demonstrate usefulness or threat potential. Time is a resource.
interpersonal_modes.threats: Predatory focus. Threats are problems, and problems have solutions. The solution is usually kinetic.

stress_responses.low: Heightened awareness, sharper focus. Low stress is fuel.
stress_responses.medium: Becomes curt and demanding. Efficiency overrides courtesy.
stress_responses.high: Hyper-focused tunnel vision. Peripheral concerns disappear. Only the threat exists.
stress_responses.critical: Berserker clarity. Everything becomes simple: survive. Deal with the rest later. The simplicity is almost peaceful.

contradictions: Despises corporate culture but has unconsciously adopted its efficiency metrics and self-optimization language
Preaches independence but is desperate for approval from people they respect
Claims to work only for money but regularly takes underpriced jobs that serve personal justice
habits: Never drinks anything they didn't see poured or open themselves
Counts ammunition obsessively — knows the exact round count at all times
Carries a specific caliber round as a lucky charm — has never fired it
breaking_points: Watching someone they trained or mentored die on a job they recommended
Being forced to choose between a crew member and the mission — and choosing wrong
Being forced to harm a civilian — collateral damage that can't be rationalized

physical_description.heritage: Ubiquitous Diaspora phenotype: 38.5% East Asian, 31.7% South Asian, 18.8% Sub-Saharan African, 11% Hispanic/Latin American. The genetic blend creates a striking multi-continental appearance — warm deep brown skin drawing from Sub-Saharan African base with golden undertones from South and East Asian ancestry, enhanced by Latin American warmth in the lower face and cheekbones. East Asian eye structure with slight epicanthic fold combined with South Asian cheekbone prominence and Sub-Saharan African lip fullness creates an angular, globally-mixed visage of unexpected beauty born from continental intersection.
physical_description.build: Broad-shouldered and heavy-set, muscular beneath the weight — a physique built for durability rather than speed. Titanium mesh bone lacing gives her frame an almost architectural quality, visible as subtle rigidity in her posture.
physical_description.hair_style: Pulled back in a tight, functional braid
physical_description.eye_color: Deep brown with faint micro-circuitry visible at the iris edges
physical_description.skin_tone: Deep warm brown — rich undertones blending Sub-Saharan African base with golden warmth from South Asian and East Asian admixture, subtle peachy-warm undertones from Hispanic/Latin American ancestry, weathered by age and exposure
physical_description.complexion: Angular face with high, prominent cheekbones reflecting South Asian and East Asian ancestry blend, accented by the fuller facial structure characteristic of Sub-Saharan African and Latin American genetics. Deep-set eyes with East Asian eye shape and slight monolid, lined from age and hardship. Slight asymmetry from old scar tissue. Unfinished quality to her features — striking, unsentimental, carved rather than refined. Minimal grooming beyond function.
distinguishing_marks: Thin vertical scar running from left temple to jawline, surgical precision suggests combat injury repair.
Burn marks across the inside of right forearm in a deliberate pattern — looks deliberate, possibly ritual scarification over old injury.
Faint chrome webbing visible at the base of her neck where synthetic lung systems interface with her circulatory system.
Deep-set calluses and old break lines across knuckles from decades of hands-on work and impact training.
physical_description.visible_augmentations: Polished chrome interface ports visible at the base of her neck where synthetic lung filtration system connects. Occasional faint luminescence visible through the ports when she breathes heavily. Neural link port visible at right temple, unmarked and unadorned. No attempt to hide or cosmetically modify — the chrome is deliberately visible, worn like a scar.
physical_description.posture_movement: Stands with weight distributed forward on the balls of her feet, shoulders slightly elevated — a ready stance she never quite relaxes from. Moves economically, no wasted motion. Breathing is audibly synthetic when exertion is high, a faint mechanical wheeze beneath organic effort.
physical_description.clothing_style: Tier 2 utilitarian — reinforced tactical jacket in matte black with internal pockets for tools and contracts. Worn cargo pants with cargo pockets and reinforced knees. Steel-toed boots, well-maintained but scuffed from field work. No jewelry. Clothes are functional, durable, and completely devoid of status markers or aesthetics beyond practicality.
